purpose: The one list of pnpm overrides in the repository (root ADR-0158). tools/npm/security-overrides.mjs renders it into pnpm.overrides of every package.json that sits beside a tracked pnpm-lock.yaml (the trees are asked of git, never listed) and `check` refuses a manifest, a lockfile overrides block or a resolved version that disagrees. kind=security is a floor: every dependency declaring a range inside [from, end of version's release line) is rewritten to ^version, so a tree already above the floor keeps its release; `from` defaults to the start of version's line (major, or minor under 0.x) and is written only to reach older lines. An entry reaches a tree only when that tree resolves the package inside the range, or when `trees` names it. kind=technology-pin takes its exact version from tools/technology-versions.contract.json (version_from). Do not edit pnpm.overrides by hand; edit this file, then `node tools/npm/security-overrides.mjs render` and `bash tools/npm/refresh-locks.sh`.

overrides.reason: Transitive through the OpenTelemetry gRPC exporter; 1.14.5 is the first fixed 1.14 release.
Three ReDoS/expansion advisories on the 5.x line pulled by minimatch 10.
Development-server file read (0.27.3 up to 0.28.1) and request forgery (below 0.25.0). Every 0.x line is lifted because tools such as wrangler pin an exact older esbuild.
Address parsing advisories on the 10.x line pulled by socks.
Parser advisories on the 4.x line; @redocly pinned 4.3.1, one release short of the fix.
Prototype pollution bypassing trust restrictions, 0.11.0 up to 0.18.2; markdownlint's micromark-extension-math declares the 0.16 line, so the floor reaches down to the first affected line.
Rendering advisory on the 14.x line pulled by markdownlint.
Integer overflow in nanoid(size) on the 5.x line (size-limit -> estimo); the 3.x line postcss uses is unaffected and stays on its own line.
Package fetch advisory on the 21.x line.
Parser advisories on the 8.x line; next pins postcss 8.4.31 exactly. Two later advisories on 8.5.15 are accepted in tools/osv-vulnerability-baseline.tsv until the CSS toolchain moves.
Bundled libvips, libheif and librsvg advisories; every release below the floor is affected.
Denial of service on malformed TOML, pulled by markdownlint-cli2.
Source map parsing advisory on the 1.x line pulled by postcss.
HTTP client advisories fixed in 7.29.1 on the 7.x line (wrangler and miniflare).
Every tree builds with the one vite the technology contract pins, whoever pulls it in.
